# Giverny: Claude Skills Directory

> Giverny is a searchable directory of 10,838 free, open-source Claude skills (Agent Skills / SKILL.md) for Claude Code, collected from 316 public GitHub repos and refreshed weekly. Each skill page explains what the skill does and how to install it; on the site, people copy one prompt and Claude Code installs the skill.

## What are Claude skills?

Claude skills are folders of instructions, scripts and resources that Claude loads when a task needs them. Each has a SKILL.md file with a name and description. Claude reads the description and loads the full skill when a request matches. They work in Claude Code, the Claude apps and the Claude API, and in other agents that read SKILL.md.

## How to install a Claude skill

- One command in a terminal: `npx skills add owner/repo --skill skill-name`
- As a Claude Code plugin: `/plugin marketplace add owner/repo` then `/plugin install plugin@marketplace`
- By hand: copy the skill folder into `~/.claude/skills/`
- On Giverny: sign in with GitHub, copy the skill's prompt, paste it into Claude Code.

## Browse by section

- [Claude Skills for Design and UI](https://giverny-two.vercel.app/claude-skills/design): 1,172 skills. Claude design skills teach Claude to build interfaces with real taste: a committed aesthetic instead of a template, solid design systems, motion that feels hand-made, accessibility checks, and platform rules for iOS, Android and the web. Use them in Claude Code whenever you build or polish UI.
- [Claude Skills for Video, Images and Audio](https://giverny-two.vercel.app/claude-skills/video): 840 skills. Claude video and media skills let Claude edit footage with FFmpeg, build motion graphics in code with Remotion and HyperFrames, generate images, video and music with models from fal.ai, MiniMax and others, and handle voice and audio with ElevenLabs.
- [Claude Code Skills for Developers](https://giverny-two.vercel.app/claude-skills/coding): 6,178 skills. Claude Code skills for developers add proven engineering workflows (planning, test-driven development, debugging, code review) and deep knowledge of specific stacks: security audits, performance, authentication, databases, cloud and mobile. Many come straight from the teams behind the tools, like Stripe, Supabase, Cloudflare, Sentry and Vercel.
- [Claude Skills for Marketing and SEO](https://giverny-two.vercel.app/claude-skills/marketing): 1,003 skills. Claude marketing skills cover SEO and AI search (GEO), copywriting, conversion rate optimisation, paid ads, email, social media and growth strategy, so Claude can audit pages, write campaigns and plan launches like a seasoned marketer.
- [Claude Skills for Documents and Productivity](https://giverny-two.vercel.app/claude-skills/productivity): 1,645 skills. Claude productivity skills handle Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files, product management, research, writing, notes and business analysis, so Claude turns raw material into finished deliverables.
- [Full directory](https://giverny-two.vercel.app/claude-skills)
- [Search](https://giverny-two.vercel.app/?q=)

## Best Claude Skills for Design and UI

- [Frontend Design](https://giverny-two.vercel.app/skills/frontend-design): Anthropic's own skill for distinctive, production-grade interfaces. It makes Claude commit to an aesthetic instead of falling back on generic layouts. (by Anthropic)
- [Theme Factory](https://giverny-two.vercel.app/skills/theme-factory): Ten preset color and font themes Claude can apply to slides, docs, reports and landing pages, or a new theme generated on the spot. (by Anthropic)
- [Brand Guidelines](https://giverny-two.vercel.app/skills/brand-guidelines): A working example of a brand skill. Fork it, swap in your colors and type, and Claude keeps every artifact on brand. (by Anthropic)
- [Canvas Design](https://giverny-two.vercel.app/skills/canvas-design): Posters and visual art as PNG or PDF, built from a written design philosophy first. (by Anthropic)
- [Algorithmic Art](https://giverny-two.vercel.app/skills/algorithmic-art): Generative art with p5.js: seeded randomness, flow fields and parameters you can tune live. (by Anthropic)
- [Web Artifacts Builder](https://giverny-two.vercel.app/skills/web-artifacts-builder): Multi-component HTML artifacts with React, Tailwind and shadcn/ui, bundled into a single file. (by Anthropic)
- [UI UX Pro Max](https://giverny-two.vercel.app/skills/ui-ux-pro-max): A searchable design library of styles, color palettes, font pairings and UX rules across web and mobile stacks. Claude picks a full design system before it writes code. (by Next Level Builder)
- [Awesome DESIGN.md](https://giverny-two.vercel.app/skills/awesome-design-md): 84 design systems analysed from real sites like Linear, Apple, Notion and Figma, each as a DESIGN.md. Drop one in your project and Claude builds in that visual language. (by VoltAgent)
- [Taste Skill](https://giverny-two.vercel.app/skills/taste-skill): Art direction, real reference photos and a browser check, so Claude builds company-grade websites instead of a template landing page. (by Leonxlnx)
- [Impeccable](https://giverny-two.vercel.app/skills/impeccable): A design vocabulary for your agent: polish, bolder, critique, audit. Includes a detector and an optional hook that catches AI slop before Claude calls the work done. (by Paul Bakaus)
- [Emil Kowalski's Skills](https://giverny-two.vercel.app/skills/emil-skills): 20 skills from the maker of Sonner and Vaul: animate, choreograph, gestures, animation reviews, Apple-style design and design-engineering taste. (by Emil Kowalski)
- [Playground](https://giverny-two.vercel.app/skills/playground): Self-contained HTML playgrounds with visual controls and a live preview, including templates for exploring design options. (by Anthropic)

- [Slack GIF Creator](https://giverny-two.vercel.app/skills/anthropics-skills--slack-gif-creator): Knowledge and utilities for creating animated GIFs optimized for Slack. Provides constraints, validation tools, and animation concepts. (by Anthropic)
- [Canopy Part Title](https://giverny-two.vercel.app/skills/heygen-com-hyperframes--canopy-part-title): Leaves sweep through the frame and part to reveal the headline. HyperFrames block, 1920×1080, 12s, 11 variables. (by HeyGen)
- [3D Asset Generation](https://giverny-two.vercel.app/skills/openmontageinc-openmontage--3d-asset-generation): Generate, reconstruct, inspect, and route production 3D assets for OpenMontage worlds using Atlas Cloud, fal.ai, licensed catalogs, and Blender. (by OpenMontageInc)
